description: Generate a validated listing payload, x402 resource draft, MCP descriptor, GitHub readiness workflow, README snippet, and registry copy for one paid endpoint.

asset.description: USDC token contract on the declared payment network; omit to use the Base USDC default.

description.description: Public description of the task the service performs and the result it returns.

endpoint.description: Provider-owned public HTTPS x402 endpoint to prepare for listing.

method.description: HTTP method accepted by the provider endpoint, for example POST.

name.description: Public name of the provider's service.

network.description: Payment network accepted by the provider, for example base or eip155:8453.

owner_contact.description: Optional public business contact for generated drafts. Omit private addresses; never supply credentials.

owner_url.description: Public website identifying the service provider.

price_usdc.description: The provider's per-call price in decimal USDC, not Ontario's publication fee. Kit generation is free.

tags.description: Comma-separated public capability tags, for example x402,paid-api,agent-tool.

name: x402_launch_kit

artifacts.description: Unpublished drafts, not proof of endpoint readiness or catalog placement.

title: X402 Launch Kit
